name: Kango Nisshi Mania
source:
Main character becomes president's secretary and moves to a Western-style mansion. He lusts for chairman's only daughter Hikaru, but can not openly show his feelings.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成为社长秘书，搬进一栋西式宅邸。他对理事长的独生女一条光心怀欲望，却无法公然表露感情。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vndb-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
